reasons: The per-semester limit of 4 MC is too low to complete the required prerequisites for the mandatory courses. For example, CS2109S requires CS2040S (completed) and a math module (MA1521 completed), but also requires (MA1511 and MA1512) or MA1521 or MA2002 or MA1102R or MA1312 or MA1507 or MA1505. The student has MA1521, so that prerequisite is met. However, CS2103T requires CS2030S (completed) and CS2040S (completed). CS3219 requires YSC3232 (not offered) or CS2103/CS2103T/CS2103DE/CS2113T/CS2113. Since YSC3232 is not offered, the student must take CS2103T (or CS2103/CS2113) to unlock CS3219. CS2103T is 4 MC. CS3219 is 4 MC. CS2101 is 4 MC. CS2100 is 4 MC. CS2109S is 4 MC. CS3213 is 4 MC. CS4221 is 4 MC. ST2334 is 4 MC. The student has completed CS1101S, CS2030S, CS2040S, CS1231S, MA1521, MA1522, IS1108, ES2660. Remaining mandatory: CS2100, CS2101, CS2103T, CS3219, CS2109S, CS3213, CS4221, ST2334. Total 8 courses x 4 MC = 32 MC. Semesters 3-8 is 6 semesters. 6 * 4 = 24 MC capacity. 32 > 24. Impossible to fit all mandatory courses within the 4 MC/semester limit.
